preserve_existing_ready: No current ready receipt is inspected for currency, overwritten, invalidated or changed by this proposal. Work is restricted to the104 absent receipts in the supplied projection.
readiness_boundary: Step1 readiness records completed authorship/status, not mathematical proof acceptance. Native exit status alone does not discharge explicit current mathematical obligations.

cta-h1-solver.statement: Semiclassical H1 right-solver and exact CGO correction with the actual product/phase/boundary hypotheses and the stated O(h^-1) bound.

cta-beam-ray-limit.statement: Finite self-intersection Gaussian-beam patching and cross-term/remainder ray-limit estimate for every actual nontangential segment; retain unoriented transversal scope.
source_leads: DS Ferreira–Kurylev–Lassas–Salo, arXiv1305.1273, Gaussian-beam construction; exact locator requires assigned author binding.

cta-four-exact-solutions.statement: Four actual harmonic solutions with nonzero transverse Gaussian product at the intersection, high-order mixed remainder control and longitudinal phases whose product leaves the prescribed Fourier frequency.
source_leads: Feizmohammadi–Oksanen, arXiv1904.00608v3; exact actual four-factor scope and locator require assigned author binding.

root-kirby-normalization.statement: Convention-specific Kirby-color slide/blow-up identities, nonzero Gauss sums and actual weighted-Lagrangian Maslov/kappa normalization for the stated BHMV parameter.
source_leads: BHMV, Topological Quantum Field Theories Derived from the Kauffman Bracket, §§1–4; actual locator and normalization require author binding.

root-handlebody-spanning.statement: Actual finite admissible spine states span the specified radical quotient; do not infer handlebody spanning from the finite simple-label list alone.
source_leads: BHMV §§3–4; Gelca, TQFT with Corners Based on the Kauffman Bracket §§3–4; Chen arXiv1502.06845v1 Chapter6.

root-pairing-and-gluing.statement: Actual normalized handlebody pairing nondegeneracy and inverse sewing/gluing maps with the original anomaly conventions; includes the torus dimension application.
source_leads: BHMV §§1–4 and Gelca §§3–4; exact primary source statement must be bound by author/reviewer.

conway-well-definedness.statement: Existence and uniqueness of the ambient-isotopy invariant of oriented link types with values Z[z], unknot1 and positive-minus-negative crossing equal to z times oriented smoothing.
source_leads: Garaev, Elementary proof of existence of the Alexander-Conway polynomial, arXiv2012.03086 §§1–4 pp1–9

source_lead_limit: Sources above are navigation from actual current Facts and native author notes, not new claims that their exact imported interfaces have already been read/accepted. Assigned source authors/reviewers must earn the precise binding.
open_problem_boundary: One question/status carrier is not a failed proof. Preserve its recorded open/unvalidated-claimed-solution scope and do not use it as a theorem supplier.
historical230_boundary: The adopted230 original historical escalations remain at their exact accepted/local/status/import-qualified scopes. These14 receiptless current Facts obligations are not a reopening or rejection of that registry.
